decision_notes: The council website explicitly designates its YouTube service. Two distinct recorded sittings (329th extraordinary session, first plenary (8 October 2026) and second plenary (19 October 2026)) were visually reviewed beyond opening slates in Chromium and WebKit, with advancing decoded video, a presiding chair or member speaking in the identified chamber and an inset sign-language interpreter. This confirms selected recorded proceedings; current live, every committee/room and all language tracks remain unverified. Open the council website and its designated video service.

Official council website link only. The council copyright policy applies KOGL conditions to individually marked works; it does not establish a blanket licence for session video. Attribution and any work-specific noncommercial/no-derivatives limits must be respected. No prior consent condition for ordinary external links was identified in the reviewed policy. Audiovisual reuse remains pending.
